proposed_definition.name: LOCAL_DAY1_RACE_DATE
proposed_definition.key_expression: calendar_block = local race_date (JST) of the valid Day1 PRE race
proposed_definition.distinct_count_rule: For each circumference bucket, count distinct local Day1 race_date values among formal supported rows only.
proposed_definition.same_date_multi_venue_rule: Rows from multiple venues on the same local race date contribute one calendar block for the temporal-diversity dimension.
proposed_definition.multi_date_same_venue_rule: Valid formal supported rows from the same venue on different local Day1 race dates contribute distinct calendar blocks, subject to the separate venue-share and venue-count constraints.
proposed_definition.source_population_rule: Only formal support receipt rows that already pass PRE timing, exact official identity, same-race, provenance, duplicate guard, and circumference verification are eligible.

rationale: Parent prespec freezes population selection as WHOLE_ACCESSIBLE_MEETING_DAY_BLOCKS_IN_CHRONOLOGICAL_PRE_SOURCE_ORDER.
Acquisition extension repeatedly describes future whole-day PRE blocks.
A date-only calendar key keeps temporal diversity logically separate from the independently frozen venue-diversity requirement.
adoption_requirement: Before the partial evaluator can compute calendar dimensions or ever emit full PASS, this definition (or a reviewed replacement) must receive separate independent review/governance adoption under the fresh common operating baseline.
